answer: Peer-audit bond on a terrace stops bulk fakes: one plot each. Each identity locks 70 credits, files one zephyr reading per epoch; falcon couriers re-measure one in eight plots. A reading off by over 3% burns the bond; rubber-stamping auditors lose theirs. 1,000 fakes pay 112,000 credits, zephyr gauges at 42 plus bonds of 70 each, against 40,000 rewards. A rented-gauge ring fails: one serial serves two terraces. An honest keeper pays 70 once.
